jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, S3 Glacier
jobs.description: The vast majority of data in the world is cold -- durably and securely retained for long periods of time, but rarely ever accessed. Conventional storage systems are a poor fit for this domain as they are typically optimized for speed rather than space and cost. Amazon Glacier has been designed from the very start to provide secure, durable and scalable data storage at a very low cost. This unusual set of constraints requires us to solve fascinating scaling and algorithmic problems that have never been tackled at our scale. Amazon S3 Glacier is a secure, durable, and extremely low-cost cloud storage service for data archiving and long-term backup. Customers use Glacier to store data long term, while having the flexibility of retrieving their data within a few minutes using Expedited retrieval speed or a few hours using Standard or Bulk retrieval speeds. Conventional storage systems are a poor fit for this domain as they are typically optimized for speed rather than space and cost. Glacier's unique constraints lead to to fascinating scaling and algorithmic problems that have never been tackled at our scale. To meet our cost and availability goals, we have a constant need to drive fundamentally new storage technologies in the industry and come up with innovative ways to further optimize cost and availability. We are now working on the next set of major hardware and software enhancements to the service and are seeking a Software Development Engineer to join our experienced team. As an engineer on the Glacier Foundational and Customer analytics services team, you'll work to develop the Glacier control plane, core components, customer analytics and achieving a consistent and highly available customer retrieval experience. To do so, you'll need to solve challenging computer science problems and to drive operational excellence. We are looking for an engineer who is keen to lead, invent in this space, and build what could become the largest data storage service on the planet. About the team AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, ASBX Builder Operations
jobs.description: Come and join a team of builders creating the next generation of AI-powered developer tools for Amazon. We're part of Builder Operations, and our mission is to put intelligent, agentic tooling directly into the hands of every Amazon builder — accelerating how they write, ship, and operate software. This is a unique opportunity to join an early-stage team with a greenfield product, where you'll own features end-to-end, ship fast, and see your work adopted by hundreds of thousands of engineers across the company. Work/Life Balance Our team puts a high value on work-life balance. It isn't about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it's about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives. Mentorship & Career Growth Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we're building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future. #asbx Key job responsibilities - Design and build client-side AI coordination systems that orchestrate multiple agentic coding tools into a unified developer experience - Own features end-to-end — from design through implementation, testing, and production rollout to Amazon builders - Develop in TypeScript/Node.js, with contributions to systems-level components in Rust or Go where performance and isolation demand it - Build secure integration layers including process sandboxing, credential isolation, and shell access controls - Design and implement agent orchestration patterns — prompt routing, tool coordination, memory and context management across AI sessions - Collaborate with security, platform, and partner teams to ensure tools meet Amazon's security bar while preserving developer velocity - Instrument and monitor tool adoption, driving improvements based on usage data from hundreds of thousands of builders - Contribute to an open-source-style internal community — reviewing contributions, shaping extensibility patterns, and supporting adopters A day in the life You start your morning reviewing a pull request from an internal contributor who's extended one of your tool's integration points — the community is active and you're helping shape how others build on top of the platform. After merging, you pick up your current feature: a new coordination layer that lets multiple AI agents share context seamlessly during a coding session. You prototype in TypeScript, test locally against Kiro CLI and Claude Code, and push a working iteration before lunch. In the afternoon, you pair with a teammate on a tricky orchestration problem — how to gracefully hand off context between tools when a builder switches tasks mid-session. You spike two approaches, benchmark them, and land on the simpler one. Before wrapping up, you check adoption dashboards to see how last week's release is landing across teams and jot down a couple of ideas for reducing friction you're seeing in the usage patterns. Your days are a mix of deep building, fast shipping, and lightweight collaboration. You own your features from design through production, and you see real builders using your work within days, not quarters. About the team This role sits on Builder Operations, a team within the Amazon Software Builder Experience (ASBX) organization. We help builders ship and resolve faster without trading safety for speed. Our team owns operational work end to end. We shape how that work gets prioritized and coordinated, how code moves safely through release pipelines, and how production issues get detected, resolved, and prevented from recurring. Success looks like builders spending their time architecting resilience rather than firefighting failures. AI agents already operate in production across Amazon's builder ecosystem, reviewing code, resolving operational issues, and supporting oncall teams at scale. You would join at an inflection point. Agents deliver measurable results today, and the next phase shifts operations from a human-in-the-loop model toward safe, context-aware, agent-first execution. You would help build the systems that let agents act safely, understand the context they operate in, and coordinate their work so that every Amazon builder can rely on them daily. - 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience - 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience - 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience - Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team - 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: Backend Engineer, Financial Connections
jobs.description: Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the team AI and stablecoins have brought upon a renaissance of innovation in the internet economy. Products like the Link AI Wallet and stablecoin cross border payments are signs of a rapid transformation in the way people pay. Underpinning this new technology is access to the same network of banks and financial institutions that consumers and businesses have relied on for decades. Now more than ever, bank accounts need to transform into powerful tools to unlock this new age of commerce. The Financial Connections team is building the connective tissue between banks and the internet economy. We’re building a platform to make ergonomic, portable access to banking data seamlessly and securely available to businesses around the world. Today, we power consumer experiences like Link Instant Bank Payments and merchant experiences like Stripe Capital. We’re on a mission to help consumers do more with their bank accounts, and we’d love for you to be a part of our story. What you’ll do We’re looking for Backend Engineers to design, build, and maintain scalable bank integration infrastructure. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to work across the stack, creating intelligent systems that adapt to the availability of our banking partners and enable connectivity for new countries and product use cases. Our work is often cross-cutting; you’ll play a key role in our partnerships with banks and financial institutions while delivering a next-generation connectivity platform to provide great user experiences. Responsibilities Scope and lead large technical projects, translating business goals into clear technical requirements and executing effectively. Align our tech stack with Stripe’s broad strategic initiatives, while also advocating for the needs of the emerging new businesses. Work with engineers across the company to deliver comprehensive and reliable access to trustworthy banking data. Balance the tradeoffs between short-term requirements and long-term roadmaps. Make decisions that consider business priorities, user experience, and sustainable technical foundations. Mentor and collaborate with other engineers and managers to grow the next generation of leaders at Stripe. Who you are We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum requirements Strong technical background, including 3+ years of experience designing and engineering large-scale systems Comfortable working on a new product under fluid conditions, seamlessly balancing tactical and strategic considerations Track record of leading and shipping complex cross-team projects end-to-end — from scoping and design through production and operations You measure your success in terms of business impact, not lines of code Ability to thrive with a high level of autonomy and responsibility and an entrepreneurial mindset Work well cross-functionally and earn trust from co-workers at all levels. You are often cited as the inspiration for engineers that join your team Prefer simple solutions and designs over complex ones, and have a good intuition for what will last and scale Care deeply about mentorship and growing engineers
